text.tspan: Monthly average surface temperatures by year World
The temperature of the air measured 2 meters above the ground, encompassing land, sea, and in-land water

tspan.tspan: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2026)
The numbers 1 to 12 on the horizontal axis represent the months of the year, from 1 for January to 12 for December. For clarity, the

text.tspan: year 2020 and subsequent years are highlighted in red.
